mountOwnership.policy: first claim owns; waiting controllers take over after release
mountOwnership.integration: use disjoint text roots and one engine copy

inlineNoWrap.supported: ordinary white-space:nowrap inline phrases within wrapping rich text

nameGrouping.scope: capitalized names followed by street or institution designators
nameGrouping.policy: bounded soft preference; substantial final location words allowed in titles
nameGrouping.limit: not a semantic parser or arbitrary brand recognition

keep.option: keep: string[] (DOM, mount and both React adapters)
keep.matching: case-insensitive; NBSP and runs of spaces count as one space; punctuation around the phrase ignored
keep.body: never split where the phrase fits the measure; a phrase the browser splits may earn one extra line, except with density: compact; a phrase longer than the measure is split as few times as possible
keep.titles: kept within the minimum line count
keep.retention: a native layout is retained only if it splits no kept phrase

defaults.density: compact with one-line default body allowance for stranded sentence/clause openers; explicit compact/maxLines respected

copy.option: copy (data-typeset-copy on the loaders, the copy prop on the React adapters)
copy.on: a document copy handler puts composed text on the clipboard as its source, without generated line breaks or engine markers, and yields to copy handlers the page registered first
copy.off: the browser copies the element itself, with a line break at every composed line end; the handler is installed only when some composed element has copy on

coverage.option: coverage (data-typeset-coverage on the loaders, the coverage prop on the React adapters)
extended: text declared in any Latin-script language, with neutral line-end preferences
a descendant declared in another Latin-script language, set with the block's preferences
visually hidden text (the sr-only pattern) and aria-hidden elements with no width, which take no room and never hold a break
sup, sub and vertical-align: super or sub, measured in place
notExtended: br, img, svg, q and bdi
coverage.always: language tags such as en_US and english, and up to three Greek or Cyrillic letters in a row in Latin text (5 μg, α-synuclein), compose under both values

headings.off: mount(), typesetAll() and the loaders leave h1 to h6, role=heading and anything inside them untouched, with no outcome written; typeset() composes the element it is given
headings.why: a wrapped composed heading has a line break inside it, which iOS VoiceOver may read as two items; not yet checked by ear

runBudget.limit: more than 500 code points between two line-break opportunities
runBudget.why: WebKit's range geometry costs the length of the line a range is on, so measuring such a run costs its square (about 37 s for 11,000 closing quotes in 4.3)

contentSecurityPolicy.styleSrc: no 'unsafe-inline' needed: engine styles are written and restored through the CSSOM, never the style attribute
contentSecurityPolicy.scriptSrc: no 'unsafe-eval' and no inline script; allow the origin that serves the bundle
contentSecurityPolicy.trustedTypes: compatible with require-trusted-types-for 'script' and trusted-types 'none'; no HTML sinks

contour.basis: predicted finished widths using the rendering space policy

spacing.deltaBounds: -20 percent to +33 percent of each measured natural space; authored spacing retained
spacing.fallback: retain unspaced composition and report native:spacing-verification

tracking.scope: default Unicode composed left-aligned body text, after verified word spacing
tracking.fallback: roll back tracking only; report native:tracking-verification
tracking.disable: tracking: false, or data-typeset-tracking=false; spacing: false disables both finishes

scheduling.discovery: changed subtrees; no whole-document rescan for unrelated mutations
scheduling.limit: one composition, initial discovery and browser layout may exceed the batch target

untaggedLanguage: neutral Latin-script preferences; no language inference
languageTags: an underscore reads as a hyphen (en_US is en-US) and a language's name as its code (english, Deutsch, francais, español, italiano, nederlands, português); 4.3 left such blocks native:language
otherLatinLanguages: neutral preferences with coverage: extended (the default); native:language with coverage: core

react.evidence: scripts/v4/verify-react-matrix.mjs: install, server render, hydration and composition in Chromium, WebKit and Firefox; strict types against @types/react 18.3, 19.0 and latest
react.onResult: each composition's Result, after the commit

priority.auto: blocks React renders in the browser compose before first paint when on screen (on-screen work beyond about 120 ms in one frame, the one-time setup not counted, continues in the next frame), offscreen blocks in idle time; server-rendered HTML paints natively and composes after hydration

react.observers: one registry per document shared by every adapter
react.customComponentChildren: native:react-component (any component child, such as next/link's Link; a development warning says so)

nodeScope: typeset-audit CLI only; the library runs in browsers and the package declares no engines field

environment.when: jsdom, happy-dom, or an engine without a required API
environment.behaviour: every entry imports; text stays as authored; typeset() and both adapters report the outcome; mount() returns an inert controller; nothing throws

regions: aria-live other than off (empty counts as absent)
role status, alert, log, marquee or timer
liveRegions.scope: text inside a live region, and an element that contains one, through open shadow roots (slotted text, a component with a live slot) as they are when the text is composed; a role set through ElementInternals or in a closed shadow root is not seen: use data-no-typeset
liveRegions.policy: never measured, composed or rewritten; mount() and the loaders release an owned element whose region turns live, or that moves into or gains a live region, in the same mutation callback when the change is in the light DOM; a shadow tree that becomes live later (a component defined after the text composed, a role set inside its shadow root) is seen at the next resize or font load, which releases the text inside the region once: use data-no-typeset, or hide undefined components with :not(:defined)

recomposes: text edits, including framework writes to split Text nodes
fonts, including stylesheet-requested fonts in WebKit
text-spacing overrides and browser font-size settings
font, spacing and line-height transitions and animations
lifecycle.ancestorRestyles: recheck a computed layout key; compose only if it changed
lifecycle.hidden: compositions are kept while hidden and paint composed when shown
lifecycle.resize: native wrapping (data-ts-stale) while a block's composed lines no longer fit; recompose 100 ms after the size holds, or, with mount() and the loaders, once a block more than a viewport height offscreen comes that near (released to native meanwhile)
lifecycle.print: native wrapping at the paper width; composition pauses
lifecycle.translation: native:translated; breaks removed by moving Text nodes; TypesetRichText freezes
lifecycle.iframes: mount() works on same-origin iframe documents and elements
lifecycle.scheduling: near-viewport work in the next task, offscreen work in idle time or when near

cssHooks.--ts-break-display: display of every generated break; none in print, inline on screen
cssHooks.data-ts-stale: set on a block showing native wrapping until it is recomposed
cssHooks.stylesheet: dist/styles.css; the engine also installs the rules as a constructable stylesheet
cssHooks.markers: the declarations every spacing and hanging marker shares are !important in the typeset-markers cascade layer, and tracking wrappers' all: unset is a stylesheet rule that page !important rules still override; each keeps only its own margin-left or letter- and word-spacing inline, and all of them inline where constructable stylesheets are missing

errors.typeset: TypeError for a target that is not an element
errors.mount: TypeError for a root that is not a Document, Element or selector string
errors.options: development builds warn once per invalid value, unknown option or non-string selector; values keep their 4.2 behaviour; production bundles omit the checks

unsupported: justified text, and a text-align-last that differs from text-align (native:justify)
scale, rotation, perspective and nonzero Z transforms

inlineCode.supported: normal whitespace, overflow-wrap:break-word and nonnegative sliced padding/borders/margins measured in context

straight: a double quote with white space or the text's edge on both sides
a double quote with no open quotation to close (width="100")
quotes.reactDeclared: en-declared needs lang on either adapter

opticalHanging.scope: full measured leading punctuation and raster-measured optical capitals on composed lines or fitting single lines
opticalHanging.clipping: full glyph must fit available clip/padding/scrollport; partial line coverage reported
unsupported: custom font-feature/variation settings unsupported by canvas, including onum

outcomes.nativeMeans: left as the browser set it, with the reason; not an error

verification.passMeans: nonempty scope, no hard errors, no unprocessed targets
verification.reviewItems: never fail the gate; text clipped on purpose (overflow hidden or clip with text-overflow: ellipsis or -webkit-line-clamp) is the review item clipped, not an overflow error
verification.doesNotMean: aesthetic perfection, all targets composed, or source preservation without a before capture

websiteLoader.selector: automatic prose and headings; data-typeset-selector overrides
websiteLoader.noTargets: each loader logs one console.info when no element matches
websiteLoader.cdnDefault: bare jsDelivr and unpkg package URLs serve dist/typeset.global.js
